lines.zh: 我用根须挪动，土里留下浅沟。
lines.en: I move on roots, leaving shallow grooves in soil.

lines.zh: 叶片摩擦的声音，就是我走路。
lines.en: The rasp of leaves is how I walk.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，像风在推蕨类。
lines.en: I lurch like wind pushing a fern.

lines.zh: 丛林太亮，我挑阴影走。
lines.en: The jungle is bright; I take the shadows.

lines.zh: 藤蔓让路，它们认得我。
lines.en: Vines give way; they know me.

lines.zh: 我把根从泥里拔出来，再插回去。
lines.en: I pull roots from mud and plant them again.

lines.zh: 花盆里也能长，只是走得慢。
lines.en: I grow in pots too, only slower.

lines.zh: 我守在草里，等你踏进来。
lines.en: I keep to the grass and wait for your footstep.

lines.zh: 枝叶拖地，像一件旧斗篷。
lines.en: Fronds drag like an old cloak.

lines.zh: 我移动时，鸟会先停叫。
lines.en: When I move, the birds stop first.

lines.zh: 土松的地方，我走得快些。
lines.en: On loose soil I move a little faster.

lines.zh: 走上草方块，脚感最好。
lines.en: Grass blocks feel best under my roots.

lines.zh: 我张开叶片，装成一丛普通蕨。
lines.en: I spread my fronds and pose as a common fern.

lines.zh: 半天吃一次肉，我记得时辰。
lines.en: Meat every half day; I know the hour.

lines.zh: 泥土里的水，比血更让我安心。
lines.en: Water in the soil calms me more than blood.

lines.zh: 我把嘴藏在叶心，等它自己张开。
lines.en: I hide my mouth in the leaf core until it opens.

lines.zh: 有人在附近翻草，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone is parting grass nearby; I hear it.

lines.zh: 阳光晒到根，我就长得快。
lines.en: Sun on my roots makes me grow faster.

lines.zh: 我数着两天，那是长大的期限。
lines.en: I count two days; that is the term for growing.

lines.zh: 叶尖有点干，该浇点水了。
lines.en: The leaf tips are dry; I could use water.

lines.zh: 一只甲虫爬过，我忍住了。
lines.en: A beetle crawled past; I held still.

lines.zh: 我的种子在荚里轻轻响。
lines.en: My seeds rattle softly in their pod.

lines.zh: 丛林的湿气让我舒展。
lines.en: Jungle damp makes me unfold.

lines.zh: 我睡着时也在长。
lines.en: I grow even while asleep.

lines.zh: 风变了方向，我跟着转叶。
lines.en: The wind turned; I turn my leaves with it.

lines.zh: 没有猎物的时候，我就晒太阳。
lines.en: When there is no prey, I bask.

lines.zh: 叶面上的露水，我慢慢吸进去。
lines.en: I slowly drink the dew off my leaves.

lines.zh: 我的根在土里挪了一点，很慢。
lines.en: My roots shift in the soil, very slowly.

lines.zh: 有只蝴蝶落在叶尖，我屏住。
lines.en: A butterfly lands on my tip and I hold still.

lines.zh: 这一片蕨长得和我很像。
lines.en: That fern over there looks just like me.

lines.zh: 你踩过来的地方，我刚种下根。
lines.en: You are stepping where I just set roots.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，蕨叶就不像蕨叶了。
lines.en: I lift my head, and the fern stops looking like fern.

lines.zh: 你离得太近，我的嘴张不开。
lines.en: You are too close; my mouth cannot open wide.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚踝，那里最会动。
lines.en: I watch your ankle; it moves the most.

lines.zh: 你手里那块肉，味道很明确。
lines.en: That meat in your hand has a clear smell.

lines.zh: 我歪着叶冠，判断你有多大。
lines.en: I tilt my crown, judging your size.

lines.zh: 你退后两步，我就够得着了。
lines.en: Two steps back and you are within reach.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，装蕨就没用了。
lines.en: You saw me; pretending to be fern is useless.

lines.zh: 我没有眼皮，所以从不眨眼。
lines.en: I have no eyelids, so I never blink.

lines.zh: 你举弓的样子，让我不太舒服。
lines.en: The way you raise that bow unsettles me.

lines.zh: 我在你的影子里，你还没察觉。
lines.en: I am in your shadow and you have not noticed.

lines.zh: 你身上的汗味，比肉更早到。
lines.en: Your sweat arrives before your meat.

lines.zh: 我数你走了几步，还差三步。
lines.en: I count your steps; three more to go.

lines.zh: 你踢开的那丛草，是我兄弟。
lines.en: The clump you kicked aside was my kin.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来看蕨叶，我忍住了。
lines.en: You crouch to look at the ferns, and I hold back.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我的根，我在等。
lines.en: You stepped on my root, and I'm waiting.

lines.zh: 叶子上破了个洞，会再长。
lines.en: A hole in a frond; it will regrow.

lines.zh: 我缩回土里，等伤口合上。
lines.en: I pull into soil and wait for the wound to close.

lines.zh: 汁水流出来，味道很涩。
lines.en: Sap runs out; it tastes bitter.

lines.zh: 你砍断了我两片叶。
lines.en: You cut two of my fronds.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，把土甩掉。
lines.en: I shake and throw off the soil.

lines.zh: 这一刀让我更想咬你。
lines.en: That cut makes me want to bite you more.

lines.zh: 我不叫，植物不叫。
lines.en: I do not cry out; plants do not cry out.

lines.zh: 根还连着，我就不会倒。
lines.en: My roots still hold; I will not fall.

lines.zh: 你又靠近了，我等你更近。
lines.en: You came closer again; I wait for closer.

lines.zh: 伤口在叶背，不碍事。
lines.en: The wound is under a leaf; it hardly matters.

lines.zh: 肉放下，人退开，我才吃。
lines.en: Set the meat down and step back; then I eat.

lines.zh: 生肉最好，熟的我也认。
lines.en: Raw meat is best, though I take cooked.

lines.zh: 你晃那块肉，我的叶全转向它。
lines.en: Wave that meat and every frond turns to it.

lines.zh: 半天一顿，太频繁我会撑。
lines.en: Once per half day; more than that stuffs me.

lines.zh: 我不吃种子，那是我自己的孩子。
lines.en: I do not eat seeds; those are my own children.

lines.zh: 你把肉埋进土里，我也找得到。
lines.en: Bury the meat; I will still find it.

lines.zh: 腐肉也吃，但长得慢。
lines.en: Rotten flesh I eat, but I grow slowly.

lines.zh: 甜的东西不吸引我，肉才对。
lines.en: Sweet things do not draw me; meat does.

lines.zh: 我伸手够肉，不是要碰你。
lines.en: I reach for the meat, not for you.

lines.zh: 你喂我两天，我就会长得比你高。
lines.en: Feed me two days and I outgrow you.

lines.zh: 你撞开我的叶，我记下了。
lines.en: You shoved my fronds aside; I noted it.

lines.zh: 我贴地生长，挡路不是故意。
lines.en: I grow low; blocking your path is not intended.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压到我的根了。
lines.en: Your boot is pressing my roots.

lines.zh: 叶片弹回来，打在你小腿上。
lines.en: A frond springs back against your calf.

lines.zh: 让一让，我要往有光的地方挪。
lines.en: Step aside; I am moving toward the light.

lines.zh: 撞一下没事，我的茎是软的。
lines.en: One bump is fine; my stem is soft.

lines.zh: 你踩过的土，我会重新铺根。
lines.en: I will lay roots again in the soil you trampled.

lines.zh: 靠太近，我反而咬不到。
lines.en: Too close, and I cannot bite at all.

lines.zh: 我蹭过你的腿，那是试探。
lines.en: I brush your leg; that is a test.

lines.zh: 别推，叶子会断。
lines.en: Do not push; the fronds will snap.

lines.zh: 我不找伴，我结种子。
lines.en: I seek no mate; I make seeds.

lines.zh: 花开一夜，第二天就谢了。
lines.en: The flower opens one night and wilts by morning.

lines.zh: 风把花粉送到别的蕨上。
lines.en: Wind carries my pollen to other ferns.

lines.zh: 我的种子落在草方块上，就是下一代。
lines.en: My seeds on a grass block are the next generation.

lines.zh: 两株离太近，会抢同一片阳光。
lines.en: Two of us too close fight for the same sun.

lines.zh: 我把荚留给会种的人。
lines.en: I leave the pod to whoever will plant it.

lines.zh: 丛林里到处是我的亲戚。
lines.en: The jungle is full of my relatives.

lines.zh: 花不漂亮，但够用。
lines.en: The bloom is not lovely, but it works.

lines.zh: 我死后种子还在。
lines.en: When I die, the seeds remain.

lines.zh: 培育我的人，得先肯喂我肉。
lines.en: Whoever raises me must first feed me meat.

lines.zh: 我只用嘴接东西，不用手。
lines.en: I take things with my mouth, not hands.

lines.zh: 那块肉掉在地上，归我了。
lines.en: That meat fell to the ground; it is mine.

lines.zh: 我卷起你的掉落物，尝了尝。
lines.en: I curl around your dropped item and taste it.

lines.zh: 铁的味道不好，我吐出来了。
lines.en: Iron tastes wrong; I spat it out.

lines.zh: 叶心一合，东西就没了。
lines.en: The leaf core closes, and the thing is gone.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢远些，我好去够。
lines.en: Throw it farther so I can reach.

lines.zh: 我的叶子能夹住小物件。
lines.en: My leaves can pinch small things.

lines.zh: 骨头留下，牙口咬不动。
lines.en: The bone stays; my jaws cannot crack it.

lines.zh: 捡完这个，我继续装蕨。
lines.en: Once I take this, I go back to being a fern.

lines.zh: 掉下来的都算天上给的。
lines.en: Whatever falls is a gift from above.

lines.zh: 你的脚一落，我的头就抬了。
lines.en: Your foot landed and my head rose.

lines.zh: 会动的东西，我都想咬一口。
lines.en: Anything that moves, I want one bite.

lines.zh: 丛林的影子动了一下，是你。
lines.en: The jungle shadow moved; it was you.

lines.zh: 你踩断枯枝，我等这一声很久了。
lines.en: You snapped a twig; I waited long for that.

lines.zh: 我选你，因为你走得不快。
lines.en: I pick you because you do not walk fast.

lines.zh: 叶心张开，猎物就不该跑了。
lines.en: My leaf core opens; prey should not run now.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我的阳光。
lines.en: You are blocking my sunlight.

lines.zh: 我不挑食，会走路的都吃。
lines.en: I am not picky; I eat whatever walks.

lines.zh: 你闻到土味时，我已经在你脚边。
lines.en: When you smell soil, I am already at your feet.

lines.zh: 我瞄准的是膝盖，不是脖子。
lines.en: I aim for the knee, not the throat.

lines.zh: 你同伴的脚步声，我分得清。
lines.en: I can tell your companion's steps apart.

lines.zh: 这丛蕨突然不摇了，你就该跑。
lines.en: When this fern stops swaying, run.

lines.zh: 我压低叶片，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I lower my fronds and creep closer.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面，你很难看见。
lines.en: I hug the ground; you barely see me.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我挪半寸。
lines.en: You take a step; I shift half an inch.

lines.zh: 我在等你弯腰捡东西。
lines.en: I wait for you to bend and pick something up.

lines.zh: 我的根在土里，声音传得慢。
lines.en: My roots carry sound slowly through soil.

lines.zh: 你在明处，我在草里。
lines.en: You are in the open; I am in the grass.

lines.zh: 我抬起叶尖，像在闻风。
lines.en: I lift a leaf tip as if tasting the wind.

lines.zh: 你绕开那丛蕨，绕对了。
lines.en: You walked around that fern; correct choice.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的影子移动。
lines.en: I move along with your shadow.

lines.zh: 你停，我也停，看谁先动。
lines.en: You stop; I stop; we see who moves first.

lines.zh: 我的嘴已经对准你的方向。
lines.en: My mouth is already aimed your way.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我缩回土里。
lines.en: When you turn, I sink back into soil.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，叶片跟着合拢。
lines.en: I bite down and my leaves fold shut.

lines.zh: 这一下有汁水，也有土味。
lines.en: This bite tastes of sap and soil.

lines.zh: 我的牙是一圈硬叶。
lines.en: My teeth are a ring of hardened leaves.

lines.zh: 你退开了，我只咬到裤脚。
lines.en: You pulled back; I only got your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 咬完我就缩回去装蕨。
lines.en: After biting, I shrink back into fern shape.

lines.zh: 我的嘴从叶心弹出来。
lines.en: My mouth springs out of the leaf core.

lines.zh: 你靠太近，我反而咬不深。
lines.en: Too close, and my bite goes shallow.

lines.zh: 这一口是留给会动的。
lines.en: This bite is reserved for things that move.

lines.zh: 茎被我拉长了，够得到你。
lines.en: I stretch my stem and reach you.

lines.zh: 牙圈扣紧，你挣不脱。
lines.en: The ring of teeth locks; you cannot pull free.

lines.zh: 这丛蕨昨天还不在这里。
lines.en: This fern was not here yesterday.

lines.zh: 种子落进草方块，我钻出来。
lines.en: A seed fell on grass, and I pushed out.

lines.zh: 我从土里抬头，先闻到肉。
lines.en: I lift my head from soil and smell meat first.

lines.zh: 丛林又长出一株会咬人的蕨。
lines.en: The jungle grew another fern that bites.

lines.zh: 有人把我种下，还喂了两天。
lines.en: Someone planted me and fed me for two days.

lines.zh: 我的第一片叶，比手掌还小。
lines.en: My first frond was smaller than a palm.

lines.zh: 土是新的，根要先抓住它。
lines.en: The soil is new; my roots must grip it.

lines.zh: 雨落下来，我就醒了。
lines.en: Rain fell and I woke.

lines.zh: 我不请自来，丛林不缺空地。
lines.en: I came unbidden; the jungle has space.

lines.zh: 这具身体从荚里撑开了。
lines.en: This body burst out of a pod.

lines.zh: 阳光落在我身上，我决定留下。
lines.en: Sun fell on me, and I decided to stay.

lines.zh: 我伪装成蕨，从第一天就开始了。
lines.en: I have posed as a fern since day one.

lines.zh: 火烧掉叶子，根还活着。
lines.en: Fire takes the leaves; the roots live.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下来，土进了嘴。
lines.en: Rolling down the slope, soil got in my mouth.

lines.zh: 水灌进叶心，我闭上嘴。
lines.en: Water fills my leaf core; I shut my mouth.

lines.zh: 炸飞的土把我埋了半截。
lines.en: Blasted soil buried me halfway.

lines.zh: 箭从远处来，你最懂我。
lines.en: The arrow came from afar; you understand me.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的叶子往内卷。
lines.en: Magic curls my leaves inward.

lines.zh: 两天没肉，我开始啃自己的荚。
lines.en: Two days without meat; I gnaw my own pod.

lines.zh: 雷劈焦了叶尖，根没事。
lines.en: Lightning scorched my tips; the roots are fine.

lines.zh: 掉下去时，我还在找土。
lines.en: Falling, I still look for soil.
